cases.reason: Preserve the original passing native proof for options_single_leg_chain_and_quote. Author review for 4.6.73: this release adds literal get_last_price diagnostic observations with a default 10 MiB encoded scalar-payload budget, explicit incomplete-capture metadata and transactionally accurate capture counters. It also normalizes legacy Phemex funding-interval hours versus newer seconds only in coverage reporting; payment timestamps, rates and cashflows are unchanged. Price fetching, returned values/types, cache and live behavior are unchanged. The retained option and attention fixtures use PandasDataBacktesting and BacktestingBroker, never the CCXT funding adapter, and do not read the diagnostic market-input exports. They retain the same prices, cash, model-visible tool results, decisions, orders and fills. No agent prompt, skill, tool schema, model wrapper or eval fixture changed. Retain exact original actor/judge sources, SDK tuple, dates, call identities, usage and verdicts; zero new model calls or hosted proof is claimed. Focused native red-first recorder/rollback and public-response funding-unit checks establish these changes independently. Completeness repair: an actual recording failure remains explicitly incomplete after later spool recovery for scalar and history observations; a persisted scalar duplicate at an optional observation limit is not counted as omitted. This changes diagnostic labels only, with focused real-SQLite red-first and rollback checks; the retained actors do not read these exports and their data, decisions and tool results remain unchanged.
